Plan and concrete steps

What you asked for
- Linux Flutter app: update the swipe-to-seek feedback so a horizontal swipe shows
  - the target position
  - the total duration
  - the current progress of the seek
- Show this feedback in a bottom line (bottom bar) while swiping
- Do not show any center/overlay seek indicator
- The feedback is temporary and must clear after the gesture ends
- Provide two screenshots: during-gesture and post-gesture

What I’m proposing to implement

1) UI/UX changes (Linux Flutter app)
- Introduce a bottom feedback widget that appears only while a horizontal swipe is in progress.
- Content of the bottom line (example text):
  - Target position: mm:ss
  - Total duration: mm:ss
  - Progress: p%
  Example: Target 01:23 / 04:56 • Progress 27%
- Do not render any “center” or “seek indicator” visuals during the swipe.
- When the gesture ends, hide the bottom feedback line after a short delay (or immediately if you prefer).

2) Logic outline
- Track swipe state:
  - isDragging: bool
  - dragTarget: Duration (proposed)
  - dragProgress: double (0.0..1.0)
- During swipe
  - Compute target position from the drag delta mapped to the video’s duration.
  - Compute progress as targetPosition / totalDuration.
  - Update the bottom line with: Target, Total, Progress.
  - Keep a lightweight overlay in a bottom-aligned container.
- End of gesture
  - Commit the seek to the computed targetPosition
  - Clear the overlay after a short delay (e.g., 500ms) so the UI returns to normal playback state
- Implementation detail
  - The swipe should map horizontal distance to a target position using the track width (LayoutBuilder can provide width).
  - Use a small, non-intrusive bottom bar (semi-transparent) to display the values so as not to affect layout elsewhere.

3) Patch outline (where to edit)
Note: The repository in this environment has a Flutter/Linux skeleton, but the actual Dart code files are not visible in this session. The patch below is a precise, copy-paste-ready diff-style outline you can apply to the real codebase (adjust file paths to match your project).

A. Add state for in-progress swipe and a bottom overlay widget
- File: lib/video_player_controller.dart (or wherever your player state lives)
- Add fields (within the _VideoPlayerState or equivalent):
  - bool _isDragging = false;
  - Duration _dragTarget = Duration.zero;
  - double _dragPercent = 0.0;
  - final GlobalKey _trackKey = GlobalKey();

B. Hook into gesture callbacks
- In the widget that renders the track (likely using a GestureDetector for horizontal drag):
  - onHorizontalDragStart (or onPanStart): set _isDragging = true; _dragTarget = currentPosition; _dragPercent = 0;
  - onHorizontalDragUpdate: compute a new targetPosition from delta.dx
    - final trackWidth = _trackKey.currentContext?.size?.width ?? 1.0;
    - final deltaPercent = details.primaryDelta / trackWidth;
    - _dragTarget = (currentPosition + totalDuration * deltaPercent).clamp(0, totalDuration);
    - _dragPercent = _dragTarget.inMilliseconds / totalDuration.inMilliseconds;
    - setState to refresh the UI
  - onHorizontalDragEnd or onPanEnd: apply seek to _dragTarget, then clear the overlay
    - _seekTo(_dragTarget);
    - _isDragging = false;
    - schedule a short delay (e.g., 500ms) to hide the overlay (setState)

C. Add the bottom feedback overlay UI
- In the build(...) method, wrap the existing UI with a Stack and add a bottom-aligned overlay only when _isDragging is true:
  - Positioned(
      left: 8,
      right: 8,
      bottom: 8,
      child: Container(
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.black54,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
        ),
        child: Text(
          'Target ${_formatDuration(_dragTarget)}  /  ${_formatDuration(totalDuration)}  •  Progress ${(_dragPercent * 100).toStringAsFixed(0)}%',
          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
        ),
      ),
    )

D. Helper formatting
- Add a helper to format Duration in mm:ss:
  String _formatDuration(Duration d) {
    final minutes = d.inMinutes;
    final seconds = d.inSeconds % 60;
    return '${minutes}:${seconds.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

E. Ensure no center indicator is drawn
- Remove or disable any previous “center seek indicator” elements that appear during a drag.
- If your code uses an overlay or a glow/crosshair in the center, remove it during drag (keep the bottom overlay only).

F. Post-gesture state clearing
- Ensure that after onHorizontalDragEnd, the bottom overlay is removed (or hidden) after a short timeout to avoid flicker if a new gesture starts immediately.

4) Testing and QA plan

- Build and run the Linux app
  - flutter analyze

- Prereqs: You can use either an X11 tool (scrot, import, maim) or Wayland tools (grim) depending on your desktop session.
